label: + penicillin allergy

edits.replace: new antibiotic last night, i'm allergic to penicillin

rationale: + penicillin allergy: a reaction after starting a new antibiotic raises the question of an allergic/hypersensitivity response, so a known penicillin allergy should heighten suspicion for a beta-lactam reaction and guide whether to stop the drug and seek urgent care.
